ui.intro: Learn to type without looking, one group of keys at a time. Each lesson opens when the one before it is mastered: 25 wpm at 95% accuracy over 30 words or more. Lessons earn XP, and count towards an XP daily goal.
ui.numpad_offer: A number pad? Kalibre has ten-key practice for it: lessons, a test, sums and a game.
ui.numpad_desc: lessons, a ten-key test, sums and a game
ui.finger_guidance_fallback: Finger guidance is for QWERTY (US) for now. You can still follow the lessons with your layout; the keys are placed as yours are.
ui.keyboard_needed: Lessons need a real keyboard: connect one (bluetooth or usb) and press any key. Tests and games work with the on-screen one.
ui.handoff_intro: You know every key now. Keep going on the typing page: timed tests and quotes build speed, and Kalibre starts noticing the mistakes you make most, so drills can work on them.
ui.opens_prereq: This lesson opens once {prereq} is mastered.
ui.review_so_far: a review of everything so far

ui.ready_test: Ready for the test whenever you are.
ui.slips_continue: A few slips still. Another go may help, or carry on when you feel ready.
ui.steno_intro: The lessons teach touch typing on a keyboard, so they’re set aside while you type with a steno machine. Tests, drills and games work as usual, and your lesson progress is kept.
ui.switch_keyboard_title: Switches “I type with” back to a keyboard
ui.needs_heading: To master it, a run needs:
